description.value: West Coast Fishing Club is a luxury all-inclusive fishing resort on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, operating since 1988 and offering guided salmon and halibut fishing from two lodges (The Clubhouse and The Outpost). Guests reach the property exclusively via a charter jet from Vancouver's South Terminal to Masset, followed by a helicopter transfer to the lodge. The resort is renowned for its conservation programs and high-end wilderness hospitality in one of BC's most remote corners.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms West Coast Fishing Club is a real, operating luxury fishing resort on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, accessible only by charter jet from Vancouver and then helicopter — there is no road or cycling access to this location. The website contains no mention of bicycles, cycling infrastructure, bike storage, laundry, tools, Wi-Fi, or any other amenity relevant to touring cyclists. The phone number 1.888.432.6666 is confirmed by the website; no street address is provided in OSM or on the website beyond the Haida Gwaii/Langara Island location.
concerns: Property is on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, with no road access; the only way to reach it is via charter flight from Vancouver and helicopter transfer — fundamentally incompatible with cycling tourism use.
No street address available in OSM or on the website.
No cycling-related amenities mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This property is physically inaccessible by bicycle or road — guests arrive exclusively by charter jet and helicopter to a remote island lodge. There is no ground route by which a touring cyclist could reach it, making it a non-viable entry for a cycling tourism directory.
